patch.verification_method: Strict unified-diff reconstruction in memory, checking old and new hunk offsets/counts and each removed/context line; no patch executable and no source/postimage file write.

source_findings.detail: Zero-initialized task_dyld_info_data_t and TASK_DYLD_INFO_COUNT capacity; checks task_info(mach_task_self(), TASK_DYLD_INFO) result and full returned count before inspecting fields, then requires 64-bit record format and nonzero address. COUNT is expressed by the SDK macro in natural_t units, not a byte count.

Checks all_image_info_size in bytes through offsetof(dyld_all_image_infos, dyldImageLoadAddress)+sizeof(const mach_header*) before reading the structure. Then requires version>=2 before reading dyldImageLoadAddress, matching the SDK field-introduction comment. Does not require unrelated libSystemInitialized or infoArray state.

Requires nonnull header, exact MH_MAGIC_64 and MH_DYLINKER. Makes the cache const to match the SDK pointer; old helpers returning mutable pointers can convert to the const cache without introducing writes. The existing generic IsDyldHdr accepts 32/64 and remains unchanged.

New aligned-version>=27 branch chooses only the TaskInfo helper. Failed validations use CHECK; the else-if preserves the existing >=13 shared-cache/fallback route below 27 and the older VM route. The new branch does not fall through to the known sampled shared-cache block call.

The entire mapping implementation suffix is byte-for-byte identical after accounting for line shifts. Both old dyld lookup helper definitions are unchanged. The patch changes only this file and does not remove mapping iteration, UUID/load-command checks, dyld inclusion or shadow-validation callers.

The retained sample directly records ASan initialization through MemoryRangeIsAvailable/get_dyld_hdr into shared-cache iteration, Block_copy, malloc, and same-thread ASan initialization lock re-entry. This supports removing the sampled route on this qualified macOS 27.0.1 build; it is not inferred from SDK declarations.

The new helper contains a stack record, a current-task task_info query, pointer reads and checks; it has no direct shared-cache enumeration or block callback. This does not establish allocation-free behavior of task_info, its library/kernel boundary, compiler-generated initialization or failure-reporting paths.

limitations.detail: No compilation, build, sanitizer execution, startup sampling, mapping/shadow acceptance, capacity admission or lease operation occurred. Source approval does not establish a successful repair.

all_image_info_size bounds the dyld_all_image_infos record, not the memory pointed to by dyldImageLoadAddress. Typed dereferences rely on readable, suitably aligned, live current-task dyld metadata during early initialization. The SDK declares the record alignment (16 bytes on nonsimulator targets) but does not by itself prove runtime pointer availability or lifetime.

The file is under SANITIZER_APPLE and dispatch uses GetMacosAlignedVersion. Its implementation/platform mapping was outside the supplied source scope. No claim is made that the branch is exclusive to macOS or qualified for other Apple platforms, 32-bit layouts, older SDKs, x86 targets or future OS releases; the offsetof/sizeof interpretation reviewed here is for the qualified macOS ARM64 layout.

Mapping suffix equality and single-file diff establish that this patch does not edit downstream mapping/shadow logic. This was not a repository-wide audit of other writers or a fresh execution of shadow-overlap protections.

later_validation_needed: Compile the exact verified postimage under the separately reviewed scratch-only preparation.

Under the separately admitted bounded native operation, verify startup reaches main without the repeated timeout, and preserve positive plus fault-detection sanitizer results and mapping/shadow validation evidence.
Retain any failure/sample and report task_info/allocation behavior only to the extent directly observed; do not describe the route as allocation-free from these declarations.
